Elements.Name: JumpPlayer
Description:
Recreates the Hedgehog Engine 1 jump cycle, where the player springs upwards before curling into a ball, complete with short hop, long jump and hurdle animations.

Tap the A button for a short hop, or hold it to jump higher and curl into a ball.

Choose which characters the jump cycle applies to.

Elements.Name: HurdleLongJump
Description: Plays the hurdle animation when long jumping at high speed, akin to Sonic Unleashed.

Elements.Name: AltDoubleJump
Description:
Turns the Double Jump into a mid-air somersault, akin to Sonic Lost World.

Please note:
- The player is vulnerable to damage during the Double Jump.
- Amy uses it by default, unless ''Jumping Hammer Attack'' is enabled or ''HE1-Jump Animation Cycle'' is set to ''All Characters''.

Elements.Name: JumpDashAnimation
Description:
Choose the animation played during the Homing Attack.

Also applies to Sonic's Jump Dash.

Elements.Name: HomingTrickRandom
Description: Shuffles the 6 Homing Trick animations instead of cycling through them in a fixed order.

Elements.Name: WallJumpAnimation
Description:
Stops the wall jump from reusing the falling animation by restoring a proper one.

Choose between the correct animation or the unused original Hedgehog Engine one.

Elements.Name: GrindBoostAnim
Description: Adds a dedicated animation when boosting on grind rails, akin to Sonic Generations.

Elements.Name: FlailFalling
Description: Replaces the spinning animation when flung off terrain with a flailing one.

Elements.Name: LegacySpinDash
Description:
Replaces the vanilla Spin Dash (SpinBoost) with the Drop Dash state, making it feel closer to its classic counterpart.

Inspired by Weezley's mod.

Please note:
- The Spin Dash is unlocked from the start.
- Unlike the vanilla Spin Dash, you cannot Spin Dash by pressing the left trigger while running.
- Charging in the air or tilting the stick while charging can sometimes release the Spin Dash in the opposite direction.

Elements.Name: WallDashAbility
Description:
Requires:
- ''Classic-styled Spin Dash''.

Exclusive to Sonic and Knuckles!!! — pun totally intended :)

Charge and release a Spin Dash while climbing to scale or launch off walls faster.

Please note:
- Only works on Open Zone climbable walls, not 2D wall jump sections.
- Sonic and Knuckles can sometimes slide down while charging.
- Technically works for Tails and Amy, but they can't climb by default.

Elements.Name: RollAbility
Description:
Replaces the redundant slide with a roll you can perform at will, similar to Sonic Adventure.

While running, press the B button to roll and gain speed.

Please note, this may conflict with other B button moves, such as Amy's Hammer Spin or Sonic's Drift when mapped to the B button.

Elements.Name: BrakeAbility
Description:
Recreates the brake mechanic from previous titles.

When braking at high speed, the player skids and gradually slows to a complete stop.
At lower speeds, the player turns around instead, as in vanilla Sonic Frontiers.

Elements.Name: FriendsDoubleJump
Description: Replaces Tails, Knuckles and Amy's Double Jump with their signature abilities.

Elements.Name: HomingSpam
Description:
Chain Homing Attacks back-to-back without the recovery delay, keeping air combos and target chains fast and fluid.

Please note, this does not affect Sonic's Jump Dash.

Elements.Name: AirBoostPhysics
Description: Choose how the Air Boost handles, based on previous boost titles.

Elements.Name: ForcesBoostJump
Description:
Recreates the Boost Jump from Sonic Forces.

Pairs best with ''Air Boost Behavior'' set to ''Sonic Forces''.

Elements.Name: SkyDiveAbility
Description:
Sky Dive at any time instead of only during scripted events, inspired by many 3D Sonic fan games.

While airborne, press the right analog stick to start skydiving.

Please note:
- The automated Sky Dive camera still applies.
- Conflicts with the Extended Photo Mode code.

Elements.Name: BoostAura
Description:
Adds a boost aura based on The Final Horizon's Rocket Boost, styled after Sonic Forces and Shadow Generations to match the Hedgehog Engine 2 look.

Turn this off if you want to use a different boost aura, such as Boost Aura P2.

Elements.Name: JumpDashTrail
Description:
Displays a trail effect when performing a Homing Attack, Stomping or rolling.

Choose whether the trail keeps following the player or only appears during those moves.

Elements.Name: JumpSpinSound
Description:
Adds the spinning sound heard when bouncing off enemies to jump ball moves, such as jumping and bouncing.

Please note:
- The Double Jump is excluded.
- Since Amy doesn't normally curl into a ball, she only gets it when jumping out of a Spin Dash or roll, unless ''HE1-Jump Animation Cycle'' is set to ''All Characters''.

Elements.Name: JumpboardBoostVoice
Description: Plays a randomized grunt when boosting off a Jump Panel, akin to Sonic Colors.

Elements.Name: CameraFOV
Description: Adjusts how the camera's Field of View reacts to your speed during gameplay.

Elements.Name: StartEmptyGauge
Elements.DisplayName: Always Start with Empty Boost Gauge
Description:
Start every Cyber Space level with an empty Boost Gauge, like in Sonic Unleashed, Colors and Forces.

Also applies to Cyber Space Challenges.

Please note, this only affects Cyber Space:
- The Boost Gauge already empties upon dying by default.
- Respawning in the Open Zone still costs rings, depending on your difficulty.
- Battle Rush, Master King's Trials and Super Sonic boss fights are unaffected.

Elements.Name: LightDashRename
Description: Renames the Light Dash to Light Speed Dash throughout the UI.

Elements.Name: SA2ShoesName
Description: Choose which name to use for the Sonic Adventure 2 Shoes in the Extras menu.

Elements.Name: JumpDashAbility
Description:
A faithful recreation of the long-lost ability, the Jump Dash, that has been overshadowed by the Double Jump and a scripted Homing Attack.

Instead of relying on the Air Boost, this ability allows Sonic to curl into a ball and dash forward, very useful for platforming and to build up speed and keep horizontal momentum.

Choose from a variety of options to set up your own preference.

Elements.Name: BounceAttackAbility
Description:
Replaces Sonic's
Stomping Attack with a now properly functioning
Bounce Attack
(or Bounce Bracelet).

This ability allows Sonic to curl into a ball and dash downwards and bounce when colliding with the ground to gain more height and reach higher platforms.

Or just to show off...

Choose from a variety of options to set up your own preference.

Elements.Name: Drift
Description:
Restores and fixes Sonic's semi-unused drift mechanic, allowing him to use it at any given moment outside of Portal 3-5: BMB or the use of the Drift Dash Panels.

Sonic's drift can allow him to take sharper turns for correcting directions and deal some damage to enemies.

Choose from a variety of options to set up your own preference.

Note(s):
- Due to how the drift state is programmed, you can sometimes get Sonic run straight when just positioning the analog stick upwards or something.
- This does not add a drift camera tilt like Amy's.

Elements.Name: SweepkickAbility
Description:
A recreation of the Foot Sweep (or Sweepkick) attack from Sonic Unleashed.

Press the B button twice while crouching or moving to allow Sonic to perform a sweep kick. This attack is effective for knocking enemies off balance.

Elements.Name: SweepkickSound
Description: Ports the Foot Sweep / Sweepkick sound from Sonic Unleashed.

Elements.Name: StateAwakening
Description:
Replaces Sonic's Power Boost cutscene with an unused real-time variant (Sonic literally jumpscares you).

This does not play the final cutscene in real-time.

Ensure that Power Boost Scene is set to off in the game settings.

Elements.Name: CyberCorruptionAlt
Description: Alters Sonic’s running animations based on his current Cyber Corruption state.

Elements.Name: CyberSpaceRun
Description: Choose different running animations for Sonic.

Elements.Name: SonicNoJumpStomp
Description: Disables Sonic being able to Jump Stomp, allowing him to simply land after a stomp.

Elements.Name: JumpDashExitAnimation
Description: Define the exit animation style after performing a Jump Dash.

Elements.Name: JumpDashStyle
Description: Define the gameplay style for the Jump Dash.

Elements.Name: JumpDashHoming
Description: Define the Homing Attack / Homing Reticle behavior during the Jump Dash.

Elements.Name: DriftInput
Description: Define the input for when performing the Drift.

Elements.Name: DriftAnimation
Description: Define the animation style for the Drift.

Elements.Name: DriftGauge
Description: Recreates the boost gauge replenishment by drifting mechanic from Sonic Unleashed and Generations.

Elements.Name: BounceAttackAnimation
Description: Define the animation style for the Bounce Attack.

Elements.Name: BounceAttackStyle
Description: Define the gameplay style for the Bounce Attack.

Elements.Name: TailSwipeAbility
Description:
A recreation of Tails' Tail Swipe from Sonic Adventure.

Press the X button while standing, moving or airborne to make Tails spin around with a powerful tail whip. This quick attack knocks back nearby enemies.

Elements.Name: FlightMeter
Description:
Replaces Tails' flight timer with a dynamic Flight Gauge, inspired by a scrapped mechanic from
SONIC THE HEDGEHOG (2006), and its fan remake P-06.

While flying, the gauge gradually depletes, draining faster when flying upwards.

Once depleted, Tails will automatically descend until the gauge is refilled.

The Flight Gauge fully recharges upon landing, allowing Tails to take off again after touching the ground.

Elements.Name: TailsHoming
Description:
Restores Tails' unused Homing Attack Skill to be on par with Knuckles and Amy.

Please note:
- Unless Disable Wrench Attack Skill is enabled, it does not disable the Wrench Attack, thus Tails may throw wrenches sometimes during a Homing Attack.
- Since Tails' Homing Attack Skill is missing a proper Training Simulator, it will send you to random Training Simulators.
- Tails can't do a Homing Attack from the ground like Knuckles and Amy unless Disable Wrench Attack Skill is enabled.

Elements.Name: TailsSpannerStop
Description:
Disables Tails' Wrench Attack Skill.

Please note:
- This option locks the Wrench Attack Skill rather than removing them entirely. You must unlock the Wrench Attack in the Skill Tree to use it again.
- Both the regular Wrench Attack and Charged Wrench Attack are affected.

Elements.Name: ScrewdriverAbility
Description:
Repurposes Knuckles' Drill Spin Attack with a recreation of the Screwdriver move from SONIC THE HEDGEHOG (2006).

While standing, hold down the X button to allow Knuckles to charge up a Screwdriver.

When released, Knuckles will launch himself upwards and slowly descend.

The longer Knuckles charges, the further he'll go.

If you release while the Homing Reticle is on-screen, Knuckles will automatically charge towards that target. Release at full charge to initiate the Drill Spin Attack.

Please note, this does not require the Drill Spin Attack to be unlocked beforehand!

Elements.Name: KnuxLegacyGlide
Description: Restores Knuckles' original glide startup animation from version 1.40.

Elements.Name: KnuxLegacyInfiniteGlide
Description: Restores Knuckles' original Infinite Glide startup animation from version 1.40.

Elements.Name: ShowHammer
Description: Displays Amy's Piko Piko Hammer during gameplay when she's at a high speed, like in Sonic Adventure.

Elements.Name: HammerAttack
Description:
Reimagines Amy’s melee combat around various Piko Piko Hammer attacks, inspired by her movesets from Sonic Adventure and fan-made interpretations such as Sonic P-06 and Extra Slot Amy for Sonic 3 A.I.R., while remaining faithful to Sonic Frontiers’ gameplay style.

This does not disable Amy’s Tarot Card abilities. She can still use abilities such as Multi-Lock, Card Spin, Card Stomp (unless Hammer Stomp is active), and Card Float.

Please note, the Homing Attack is disabled by default (except in specific circumstances), since Amy’s attacks already utilize the X button. Amy’s lack of a traditional Homing Attack should not make challenges or bosses unbeatable, as Multi-Lock can be used as an alternative for reaching airborne or distant targets

Control Scheme:
- Ground + X Button: Hammer Attack
- Airborne + X Button: Aerial Hammer Attack
- Ground + Hold X Button: Hammer Bounce
- Run + Hold B Button: Hammer Spin

Elements.Name: HammerStomp
Description: Replaces Amy’s Card Stomp with a Piko Piko Hammer-based variant.

Elements.Name: HammerJump
Description: Recreates Amy’s Hammer Jump from Sonic Adventure.

Elements.Name: HammerJumpAttack
Description: Enlarges Amy's double jump hitbox by having her spin her hammer around her, similar to Sonic Origins / Superstars.

Elements.Name: HammerRush
Description:
A recreation of the Hammer Rush from Sonic Origins / Superstars.

While running, Amy will perform continuous hammer attacks and damage everything in her path.

Elements.Name: AmyLightDash
Description:
Allows Amy to use the Light Dash like in Sonic Dream Team.

Please note, Amy can always Light Dash with a press of the left stick every time rather than when near a trail of rings.

Elements.Name: AmyBoostStop
Description:
Disables Amy’s standard boost, giving her an authentic Sonic Adventure-style feel.

Does not affect her Card Spin Boost.
